title: Smoked Mackerel Pasta
description: A quick and flavorful pasta dish featuring smoked mackerel, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the smoked mackerel fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Flake the mackerel into the skillet with the garlic and oil.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the mackerel mixture.
Season with black pepper to taste.
